title: Ambient Clinical Scribes
answer: Ambient clinical scribes are systems that listen to a patient visit and produce a draft clinical note, usually without the clinician typing during the encounter. They sit inside the broader field of clinical documentation and ambient intelligence, alongside dictation tools, coding assistants and speech recognition. The scope covers the exam room conversation, the draft note, and the handoff of that draft into the electronic health record. It does not cover diagnosis or treatment decisions, which remain with the clinician.

crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Ambient clinical scribes are systems that listen to a patient visit and produce a draft clinical note, usually without the clinician typing during the encounter. They sit inside the broader field of clinical documentation and ambient intelligence, alongside dictation tools, coding assistants and speech recognition. The scope covers the exam room conversation, the draft note, and the handoff of that draft into the electronic health record. It does not cover diagnosis or treatment decisions, which remain with the clinician.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: These systems run on a microphone or phone app that captures the visit, a cloud service that transcribes the audio, and a large language model that turns the transcript into structured note sections. Some products run speech recognition on the device and send only text onward, while others send audio to a vendor's servers. The output lands in the electronic health record, often through an integration built by the vendor or a middleware layer. Because the site tracks 850 AI tools, scribes are one crowded corner of a much larger tool market.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: The work starts with capturing audio, then separating speakers so clinician and patient turns are labelled. Speech recognition converts the audio to text, and a language model drafts sections such as history, assessment and plan, guided by a specialty template. A clinician then reviews and edits the draft before it is signed. Accuracy depends heavily on audio quality, accents, overlapping speech and how much of the visit happens away from the microphone.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: The main duties are patient consent to recording, notice of who processes the audio, and secure handling of protected health information under rules such as HIPAA in the United States. Vendors may retain audio or transcripts for model improvement unless the contract says otherwise, so retention and deletion terms matter. A clinician remains responsible for the signed note even when a model drafted it, and errors that reach the record can carry liability. The site's 229 compliance and regulation pages and 6 active product liability and wrongful death lawsuits against AI companies show how live these questions are.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: Expect scribes to move from drafting notes toward ordering suggestions, coding support and visit summaries for patients, which widens the review burden rather than removing it. Specialty tuning, better handling of accents and non English visits, and on device processing are active areas. Buyers will keep asking for clear retention terms, audit trails and evidence that drafts are accurate. The field will likely be judged less on transcription quality, which is largely solved, and more on whether the note is correct and defensible.
